scripts.test: pnpm run safety:test && pnpm --filter './packages/*' -r --if-present run test
scripts.test:migration-v2: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @enkeep/import-happyclaw test tests/migration-v2.test.ts && pnpm --filter @enkeep/platform-server test tests/migration-v2-service-and-routes.test.ts tests/migration-v2-pilot.test.ts
scripts.test:lark: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @enkeep/channel-lark run test:lark
scripts.test:host-runtime: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @enkeep/demo-runner run test:host
scripts.test:cli: pnpm run build && pnpm run docker:build-runtime && ENKEEP_RUNTIME_IMAGE=enkeep-demo-runtime:acceptance pnpm --filter @enkeep/demo-runner run test:cli
scripts.test:plugin: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @enkeep/runtime-runner run test tests/trusted-dsh-plugin.test.ts && pnpm --filter @enkeep/platform-server run test tests/extension-trusted-plugins.test.ts && pnpm --filter @enkeep/demo-runner run test tests/trusted-plugin-acceptance.test.ts
scripts.test:mcp: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @enkeep/demo-runner run test:mcp && pnpm --filter @enkeep/web-e2e run test:contract tests/contract/contract-mcp-extensions-journey.test.ts
scripts.test:controlled-mounts: pnpm run build && pnpm run docker:build-runtime && ENKEEP_RUNTIME_IMAGE=enkeep-demo-runtime:acceptance pnpm --filter @enkeep/demo-runner run test:mounts
scripts.test:docker: pnpm run build && pnpm run docker:build-runtime && ENKEEP_RUNTIME_IMAGE=enkeep-demo-runtime:acceptance pnpm --filter @enkeep/runtime-runner run test:docker && ENKEEP_RUNTIME_IMAGE=enkeep-demo-runtime:acceptance pnpm --filter @enkeep/demo-runner run test:docker && ENKEEP_RUNTIME_IMAGE=enkeep-demo-runtime:acceptance pnpm --filter @enkeep/web-e2e run test:docker
scripts.test:docker:demo: pnpm run build && pnpm run docker:build-runtime && ENKEEP_LLM_ENABLED=0 ENKEEP_RUNTIME_IMAGE=enkeep-demo-runtime:acceptance pnpm --filter @enkeep/runtime-runner run test:docker && ENKEEP_LLM_ENABLED=0 ENKEEP_RUNTIME_IMAGE=enkeep-demo-runtime:acceptance pnpm --filter @enkeep/demo-runner run test:docker && ENKEEP_LLM_ENABLED=0 ENKEEP_RUNTIME_IMAGE=enkeep-demo-runtime:acceptance pnpm --filter @enkeep/web-e2e run test:docker
scripts.verify: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm run test
scripts.demo:test: pnpm run build && pnpm run docker:build-runtime && ENKEEP_RUNTIME_IMAGE=enkeep-demo-runtime:acceptance pnpm --filter @enkeep/demo-runner run demo:test
